label: Metabolite cross-references from BridgeDb
description: List PlantMetWiki metabolites with the external cross-references materialised by BridgeDb (wp:bdb* predicates: ChEBI, Wikidata, PubChem, HMDB, KEGG, ...). These links are stored directly in the graph, so no federation is needed to resolve a metabolite to its ChEBI / Wikidata / PubChem entries.
